craft_notes: Sthāyin: void-triple (heart added). Rows: row 1 (three-voids uncut). Rupture: colon after steady — set, then rising. Close: then (tataḥ — sequence marker sings). Rejected: numbering back/root/heart — killed: list flows; 'spontaneous rising' — kept thoughtless-rising (the compound is the point).

lines: Back, root, heart voids steady contemplated:
at once from thoughtlessness — thoughtless-rising then.
